evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (dimensioned concept); masses CALC; nothing built or measured

geometry.axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x, y transverse

components.label: Ball tip
components.function: The point that touches the paper and writes.

components.label: Ink refill (D1 mini)
components.function: Standard replaceable refill.  It slides along the nose so the ball stays on the paper: about 24 mm over 35-75 deg tilt and the tip's travel (CALC, front-end closure).

components.label: Refill holder (tendon end)
components.function: Holds the refill's end.  A closed tendon loop (a capstan drive) from the ink-force drum in the pen-lift module runs forward beside the refill over a small pulley to this holder and back, so the drum moves the refill either way wherever it has slid; its rearmost position is 80 mm from the tip.
components.part: custom (holder + tendon loop + pulley; ASSUMPTION 0.5 g)

components.label: Pen lift and ink-force drum
components.function: Annular module around the refill's path just in front of the gimbal: a drum with a fatigue-rated spiral spring sets the ink force through the tendon loop; for a pen-up an electro-permanent brake locks the drum and a bistable latch turns it a little, pulling the refill back 0.5 mm; neither needs power to hold.  Near the pivot it adds almost nothing at the tip.
components.part: custom (drum + spiral spring + electro-permanent brake + bistable reluctance latch, about 2 g; ASSUMPTION)

components.label: Moving nose (refill carrier)
components.function: Thin titanium tube holding the refill; it tilts on the gimbal so the ball moves at least 6.0 mm in every direction over 35-75 deg of pen tilt.

components.label: Nose nozzle
components.function: Front of the moving nose; guides the refill tip.

components.label: Short rear arm
components.function: Carries the magnets just behind the gimbal: a short arm keeps the magnets' stroke (and the magnet-coil gap) small; the tip moves the opposite way, about 6.6 x the magnets' motion.
components.part: custom (aluminium 6061 tube 5/3.6 mm; the refill holder may enter it)

components.label: Magnet cap (2 x 2 checkerboard on soft iron)
components.function: Four magnet poles (N S / S N) on a soft-iron cap with a spherical face centred on the gimbal: tilting slides the poles along the coils at a constant gap.
components.part: NdFeB N52 segments 6.3 x 6.3 x 3.3 mm on a spherical soft-iron cap (custom)

components.label: Two-layer spherical coil plate
components.function: x and y coil layers on a soft-iron plate concentric with the cap.
components.part: custom (bonded coils on a formed plate)

components.label: Position magnet
components.function: Tiny magnet on the moving arm read by the 3-D Hall sensor.

components.label: 3-D Hall position sensor
components.function: Reads the nose position in x and y (20 kSPS single axis) for the position servo; the larger travel needs the +-50 mT range.
components.part: TI TMAG5170 (3-D Hall, SPI) or TMAG5273

components.label: Skid ring (C-shaped heel)
components.function: Rests on the paper and carries the writing force; the nose swings inside its lip. Open on the top so the ink stays visible.

components.label: Front sleeve (fixed grip)
components.function: Where the fingers rest. It does not move; the nose swings inside it.

components.label: Paper sensor (required for autowrite)
components.function: Sees the paper beside the nose: where the pen is on the page (autowrite needs it; 1 kHz, 2 ms assumed).
components.part: optical-flow sensor, to select (PMW3360 class needs a flat window 2.4 mm from the paper; ASSUMPTION)

components.label: Flexure gimbal (2-axis)
components.function: Laser-cut cross-strip flexures: the nose tilts +-4.9 deg in two directions with no friction; stiff along the pen.

components.label: Handle shell
components.function: The body you hold: 24 mm across.
components.part: PEEK or glass-filled nylon, 1 mm wall

components.label: Control board
components.function: MCU with Bluetooth, two coil drivers with current sensing, the lift driver, charger and the IMU.
components.part: nRF54L15 + 2 x DRV8214 + lift driver + charger

components.label: Motion sensor (IMU)
components.function: Accelerometer and gyroscope: with the paper sensor it tells where the handle is, 2000 times a second.

components.label: Rechargeable cell
components.function: EEMB LIR14500, 750 mAh.

components.label: Vibration cue motor
components.function: Gentle buzz cues.

components.label: USB-C port and button
components.function: Charging and mode button.

components.label: Rear cap
components.function: Closes the handle.
